props.text: PASS: sidebar scrolls without covering nav text.
This probe isolates app navigation controls: MenuBar/Menu/MenuItem, Sidebar/NavItem, Tabs/Tab, Pages/Page, badges, disabled states, selected states, and ContextMenu.
Select Analytics in the sidebar to test the active nav state.
Selected tab should have a cohesive top shape.
The badge should fit without clipping the tab label.
PASS: selected tab, badge, and accent align cleanly.
Disabled tab content should not become active.
Right-click the button to check ContextMenu placement and style.
PASS: context menu opens above content and keeps readable spacing.
Top menus should look like menus, not standalone rounded buttons.
Open states should feel attached to the menu bar.
Disabled Help should read visibly disabled.
Sidebar selection should track the active Pages value.
Nav badges should remain inside the row at narrow widths.
PASS: selected NavItem has a full-row shape, not a detached strip.
This route should not be reachable from the disabled nav item.

dirty.note: DragonGUI applies coarse dirty flags immediately; this history records the recent command reasons that triggered them.
